pages.text: There are two types of foci. $(bold)Item foci$() can be formed by using any item on a chalk mark, which will place the item into the focus. Using chalk on a chalk mark creates an empty item focus that will accept items thrown into it.
$(bold)Block foci$() are any spaces without chalk that are entirely enclosed by chalk. In other words, a complete chalk ring of any size will turn every chalkless inner space into a block focus.
